content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question about product module compatibility. I found a compatibility list online but it's not completely clear to me. Currently, I have four [article_no] expansion modules and two [article_no] base modules. I plan to upgrade the base modules to the newer [product_name] version [version_no], for example [article_no] with or without display. Are these compatible with my existing expansion modules? The compatibility list I found seems contradictory in parts ([url]). Thank you in advance.

Your concerns are understandable. The relevant point states that expansion modules with [article_no] can only be used with [product_name] base modules in the series [article_no] and [article_no] (where X = 0, 1, or 2).
That's what I suspected, so it looks like I can purchase a new base module compatible with my current expansion modules. [company_name] should consider revising the wording for better clarity.
The information has been updated. Compatibility overview for [product_name] basic and expansion modules is now clearer.

That's not entirely correct. For instance, I have base [article_no] and extension [article_no]. Point 4 says 'up to,' meaning they can be used together—basic modules from [article_no] to [article_no] are compatible with all expansion modules with [article_no]. Point 5 says 'only,' indicating they cannot be used together—expansion modules with [article_no] are only compatible with base modules of the series [article_no] and [article_no]. There seems to be a misunderstanding in the documentation's wording.
When you identify this kind of issue, why not provide feedback directly on the website and contact the page author? [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are confused and frustrated about compatibility between different [product_name] basic and expansion modules, even when referring to official [company_name] documentation. The compatibility details are viewed as unclear and contradictory, resulting in uncertainty about which modules are compatible. Users want precise and clear guidance to avoid incorrect purchases.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable, clear compatibility information about which [product_name] basic and expansion modules work together. They want confidence when purchasing newer base modules, ensuring compatibility with existing expansion modules.
